subject: Request: extra eval credits & short extension for Armada bake-off
messages:
From: Elena Park <epark@armadasystems.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@procure.armada.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Armada RFP – request for more eval credits and short trial extension

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick setup — the team has started the side‑by‑side and we’re seeing promising signal vs the incumbents. Two asks from procurement & engineering before we lock the bake‑off schedule: 1) an additional allotment of model credits (we burned through our initial pool faster than expected during long-context tests) and 2) a brief extension on the trial window (we need to include one additional integration run).

Current allocation: ~200k tokens allocated in the trial.
Request: +300k tokens and +3 weeks extension (ending 2026‑05‑24).

We’re running this as a competitive bake‑off (Armada, two other vendors). Final decision expected by mid‑June — the evaluation dataset includes long documents and PDF ingestion. If you can provide a staged top‑up (partial now, remainder on milestone), that would also work for our procurement cadence.

Attachment: RFP scope (high level).

What do you need from us to get this greenlit?

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
VP, Product & Platforms
Armada Systems
[Attachment: RFP-eval-scope.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Armada RFP – request for more eval credits and short trial extension

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Elena's ask from Armada. Highlights: +300k tokens requested, +3 weeks extension, open to staged delivery (partial now + milestone). They’re running head‑to‑head with two competitors; decision mid‑June.

Suggested approach: offer 200k immediate top‑up + up to 150k milestone credit (total 350k) and 2‑week extension (not full 3) to keep program precedent conservative. Procurement will insist on PO/MAA. We should surface any cost/finance signoff and legal redlines early.

I’ve sketched a quick allocation grid attached; please review and advise if ops/finance can approve a 350k blended arrangement. If approved, I’ll confirm with Elena (conditional on PO/MAA).

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-credit-grid.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Armada RFP – request for more eval credits and short trial extension

Mina — I’m okay with the staged plan but want to be explicit about limits: approve 200k immediate, hold 150k as contingent upon a short demo (20‑minute tech review) and a signed MAA. Finance needs the deal_id and a cost center for internal tracking (I’ve used ARM-2026-089 for now).

Notes for process:
- Immediate 200k is treated as a promotional credit (no invoice).
- Contingent 150k requires PO/MAA signature and evidence of integration test (log snippet + brief meeting).
- Any overage beyond 350k goes to standard paid trial rates.

I’ll draft the approval memo and flag for CS to capture the demo milestone. 

Attaching brief approval note for records.

Ben Carter
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credits_approval_note.txt (txt)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <epark@armadasystems.com>, Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@procure.armada.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 14:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Armada RFP – request for more eval credits and short trial extension

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks for the details and the scope doc. Good news: we can commit to a staged allocation to unblock your bake‑off. Proposed confirmation: 200k tokens assigned immediately, 150k tokens held as contingent credit to be released after a short integration/demo and a signed MAA. We can extend the trial window by 2 weeks (new end date 2026‑05‑10).

Next steps from our side:
1) I’ll route the MAA to you via DocuSign (link below) — procurement signature required to release the contingent credit.
2) Please share a PO or procurement contact reference so Finance can reconcile the promotional credit.
3) Schedule a 20‑minute integration check with our SE (I’ll coordinate CS) — demo documentation required to release the 150k.

DocuSign (MAA): https://docusign.net/ARM-2026-089/maasign
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ARM-2026-089

Files attached: proposed credit grid / MAA summary.

Happy to adjust if procurement needs a different cadence.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAA_credits_grid.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <epark@armadasystems.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Armada RFP – SOC2 and security artifacts

Hi Elena — looping in from Security. Attached is our most recent SOC 2 report summary and a short compliance one‑pager that covers data segregation, KMS integrations, and logging/audit capabilities. If you need the full report under an NDA we can route that through your legal team; we can also provide a redacted penetration test summary on request.

Attachment: SOC2_report_2025.pdf (pdf)

To confirm: staged credits and 2‑week extension are fine from a security perspective; nothing blocking the bake‑off.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_report_2025.pdf (pdf)]
